items.name: deanpeters/Product-Manager-Skills
items.one_liner: Standardized PM skill frameworks for guiding AI coding agents.
items.pain_point: AI agents lack business context and requirements precision; PMs/Founders pay.
app_ideas: AI PRD-to-Agent Pipeline: Converts business requirements into agent-executable specs.
Agentic Product Backlog Manager: Auto-prioritizes tasks using the framework's logic.
AI Agent Quality Auditor: Validates agent output against PM skill benchmarks.
items.monetization: B2B SaaS / Monthly subscription for product teams
items.why_now: Shift from simple chat to autonomous agents requires structured governance.
